rules.summary: Members resolve a module in different versions
rules.explanation: Two projects of one build that run with different versions of the same library behave differently and are tested against what the other does not ship. Align them with a platform or a version catalog.

rules.summary: Projects depend on each other in a cycle
rules.explanation: A cycle makes the projects one unit that cannot be built, tested or released apart.

rules.summary: A project depends on one it must not
rules.explanation: The workspace forbids this dependency to keep its layers apart.

rules.summary: A project of the build was not checked
rules.explanation: The project does not apply Kreate with the workspace check, so its dependencies are unknown to the workspace.
